description: Padded turns build real history, then an explicit manual summary compaction runs and a later prompt continues from the resulting checkpoint. Passing requires a completed manual/summary compaction whose rolling_summary_v1 checkpoint carries a non-empty summary and valid version fields, and a later preparation that actually dispatched a request from that checkpoint.
